scope: prior unique Workshop-to-suggestion case and isolated store transport verification

cases.name: test_unacknowledged_on_absent_subscribers_and_replay_on_installed_subscriber
cases.description: Preserves unacknowledged suggestions on absent subscribers and guarantees replay once subscriber is installed without message loss.

cases.name: test_publisher_outage_fails_closed_and_recovers_on_restore
cases.description: Publisher outage fails closed and safely recovers upon connection restoration.

cases.name: test_consumer_restart_resilience_from_sqlite
cases.description: Consumer restart recovers state and offset reliably from isolated SQLite persistence store.

cases.name: test_bff_store_routes_all_queries_and_actions_to_incidents_service
cases.description: BFF store strictly routes all queries and suggestion/incident actions to incidents service with verified terminal receipts.

cases.name: test_bff_store_emits_structured_warning_on_unhandled_action
cases.description: Emits structured warning and fail-closed receipt on unhandled action types.
